module_summary: elfldr/ is the no-IOP-reset child loader: a small EE ELF linked into BIOS-unused RAM at 0x84000 (elfldr/linkfile), embedded in the main ELF as elfldr_irx and started by src/platform/elfldr_noreset.cpp; it wipes user memory, loads the target ELF through rom0:LOADFILE with a fileXio (iomanX) rescue path, optionally cleans up HDD/PFS or resets the IOP, then ExecPS2s the target with caller-supplied argv. elfldr/Makefile is the legacy make recipe; ps2.yaml:615-624 is the real build. The include/ headers in this unit are mostly class declarations for the C++ singletons that replaced file-scope statics (AppSource, ArtIndex, BdmLauncher, BdmSupport, BgmPlayer, ConfigSet, FontSystem, Gui, HddSupport, IoQueue, MmceSupport, NeutrinoLauncher, PadManager, FolderBrowse), plus small shared inline helpers (typed BDM path rewriting, i.LINK ID parsing, native-VMC marker scan, ShanWan/DS3/DS4 report layouts, the READ_KEY NCMD wrapper), the HDL 1024-byte header layout, mode/error enums and bin2c IRX externs. The two ee_core/tests files are host tests for the in-game freeze diagnostic formatter and screen.

reusable_helpers.name: wipeUserMem
reusable_helpers.what: zeroes EE user memory 0x100000..GetMemorySize() with 128-bit sq stores (PS2Link-derived)

reusable_helpers.what: parses the slot number out of a mass<N>: path (1-2 digits)

reusable_helpers.what: rewrites mass<N>:/rest as usb/ilink/mx4sio/ata<k>:/rest with a length check

reusable_helpers.what: parses a 16-hex-digit string into 8 bytes, clears the output on bad input

reusable_helpers.name: nativeVmcSlotWord
reusable_helpers.what: finds and caches the word offset of a 0xC0DEFAC0+slot marker inside an embedded module image

findings.title: ArtIndex allocates hashes[4096] and pics[4096] (48 KB) per indexed directory regardless of its size and keeps them for the session
findings.problem: ArtIndex::build mallocs kMaxEntries*sizeof(unsigned int) = 16,384 bytes for hashes and kMaxEntries*sizeof(Pic) = 32,768 bytes for pics before the sweep and publishes those same buffers into the slot, never shrinking them to the n / picCount entries actually found. Slots are freed only when round-robin reuses them (release() via slotFor; invalidate() frees nothing), so with kSlots = 3 up to 147,456 bytes stay allocated for the whole run even when each ART folder holds a few hundred files. The index is live: artload.cpp:777 registers the art worker as owner and textures.cpp:1345,1357,1431 query it.
findings.fix: After the sweep succeeds, shrink hashes to n entries and pics to picCount entries with realloc (skip the shrink when the count is 0), before publishing them into the slot.
findings.justification: Two realloc calls are the smallest change that returns the unused tail of each array to the heap; the alternatives (a counting pre-pass or growable arrays) add more code. Concrete gain: about 46 KB per slot for a 200-file ART folder, which is >= 32 KB of EE RAM that is otherwise held for the session.
findings.benefit: INFERRED: per slot 49,152 B allocated vs 12*n B needed (n=200: 2,400 B), so ~46 KB freed per slot, up to ~140 KB with all three slots in use. sizeof(Pic)=8 from the two 4-byte members at artindexint.h:40-44.
findings.evidence: Read artindexint.h:26-92 (kSlots=3, kMaxEntries=4096, Pic {unsigned int hash; int name;}). Read artindex.cpp:180-289: malloc at :191 and :199 sized by kMaxEntries, no realloc of hashes/pics afterwards, buffers stored into slot at :281-286. Grep release(|invalidate(|free( in artindex.cpp: release() at :92-97 called only at :154 (slot reuse); invalidate() at :421 (comment at :153 says it deliberately does not free). Grep setOwnerThread/artIndexMayExist/artIndexFindPicture over src: artload.cpp:777, textures.cpp:1345,1357,1431; artindex.cpp is in the riptopl sources list at ps2.yaml:641.

findings.title: elfldr linkfile keeps each -ffunction-sections input as its own output section: ~4 KB of section headers in the embedded elfldr_irx
findings.problem: elfldr is built with -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections (ps2.yaml:619) but the linker script only collects *(.text), *(.rodata), *(.data), *(.sbss), *(.bss), so every .text.<fn>, .rodata.<fn>.str1.8 and .bss.<var> input section becomes an orphan output section: size -A lists 73 sections for bin/elfldr.elf. The ELF is embedded whole as elfldr_irx (21,476 bytes, type D in the main ELF), but the parent only reads the ELF header, the program headers and PT_LOAD data (elfldr_noreset.cpp:220-237), so the section header table and .shstrtab are dead bytes held in EE RAM for the whole run.
findings.fix: In elfldr/linkfile collect the suffixed sections into their parents: *(.text .text.*), *(.rodata .rodata.*), *(.data .data.*), *(.sbss .sbss.*), *(.bss .bss.*). Keep the flags and --gc-sections; nothing else changes.
findings.benefit: INFERRED from MEASURED sizes: blob 21,476 B vs loadable span 16,900 B (0x84000..end of .data); ~75 headers x 40 B + ~1.4 KB of names shrink to ~10 headers, so ~3.9 KB less in the unpacked main ELF and in resident RAM; the packed file gains less.
findings.evidence: Read elfldr/linkfile:1-86 and ps2.yaml:615-624 (cflags -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections, ldflags --gc-sections). evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-size-A.txt:68-143 (size -A bin/elfldr.elf: .text 5616 at 540672 followed by .text.readAll ... .text.sceSifGetSreg, .rodata.*.str1.8, .data 4 at 557568, .bss.elfdata.0). raw/artifacts.tsv:18 and raw/riptopl-top80-symbols.txt:39: elfldr_irx 21476 D. Grep elfldr_irx over the repo: only elfldr_noreset.cpp:29-30,220,227,232 (ELF header, phdrs, PT_LOAD copy). Section-header count and name bytes are estimated from the size -A listing (INFERRED); the binary was not rebuilt.

findings.title: elfldr wipeUserMem calls GetMemorySize() in the loop condition: 507,904 kernel calls on every child-loader launch
findings.problem: The loop condition i < GetMemorySize() is re-evaluated every 64 bytes; GetMemorySize is an external libkernel call (a kernel syscall, INFERRED) the compiler cannot hoist, so a 32 MB console makes (0x2000000-0x100000)/64 = 507,904 calls, and a 128 MB DTL-T10000 four times that. It runs on the EE in main() before SifLoadElf (loader.c:420) on every Neutrino, POPSTARTER, Ember and app handoff. POPSLoader's child loader has the same loop; Launchstation's loader.c:216-217 already reads the size once.
findings.fix: Read GetMemorySize() once into a local before the loop and compare against it.
findings.benefit: INFERRED: removes ~508K syscall round trips per launch; at an assumed 100-200 cycles each on the 294.9 MHz EE that is roughly 0.15-0.35 s of black screen per handoff (more on 128 MB units).
findings.evidence: Read elfldr/loader.c:219-229 and :387-475 (wipeUserMem called at :420 on every path). Grep 'i < GetMemorySize()' over src/: RiptOPL elfldr/loader.c:222 and POPSLoader src/elf_loader/src/loader/src/loader.c:74 (read :66-81). Launchstation loader/loader.c:212-224 hoists end = GetMemorySize(). That GetMemorySize is a syscall and its per-call cost are not verifiable from the repos (SDK not read): INFERRED.

findings.title: disc_key.h sysReadDiscKey is static inline with static RPC buffers, so system.cpp and sysdisc.cpp each carry their own copy
findings.problem: sysReadDiscKey is defined static inline in a header and declares static request[16] and response[64] buffers (64-byte aligned); both system.cpp (:527) and sysdisc.cpp (:230) include it, so the main ELF holds two request and two response buffers and two inlined copies of the RPC sequence.
findings.fix: Define sysReadDiscKey once (non-inline) in sysdisc.cpp and leave only its prototype in disc_key.h.
findings.benefit: MEASURED: nm shows 4 x 64 B .bss symbols (two request, two response), so 128 B .bss saved, plus one inlined copy of the call sequence (INFERRED ~100-200 B .text).
findings.evidence: Read disc_key.h:1-61. Grep disc_key.h|sysReadDiscKey over src: includes at system.cpp:7 and sysdisc.cpp:7, calls at system.cpp:527 and sysdisc.cpp:230 (both files in ps2.yaml:641). evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt:4588-4591: two _ZZL14sysReadDiscKeyhhjPhE8response and two ...E7request, 0x40 bytes each.
